name: voice-ai-observability-client
//overrides: Rollup normally loads a prebuilt native .node binary. Windows Smart App Control (and hardened/locked-down corporate machines) block unsigned native modules, which makes `vite`/`vite build` fail with ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED. @rollup/wasm-node is Rollup's official WebAssembly build — same API, no native binary, so it runs anywhere. Slightly slower builds; unnoticeable at this project's size.
